scientific_integrity: No claim of independent review; prior 2022 ring presentation explicitly credited; proof of new resolution and discrepancy is self-contained.
scientific_limitations: Kuroda (2022) already contains a general invariant-presentation theorem specializing to the ring used here; no novelty is claimed for that presentation.
Lorenzini–Schröer (2019) full text and unindexed local-resolution literature not exhaustively inspected.
Two targeted published-finding corpus queries returned internal tool failure; earlier queries succeeded, not treated as novelty proof.
Only algebraically closed characteristic-p base fields and this named cyclic action are treated; no claim of unique minimal resolution.
Finite checks for p=2,3,5,7 do not establish any infinite statement.
title: A one-blowup resolution of the positive-characteristic Anick cyclic quotient
